name: agent-chain-wrapper
description: Run AgentChain as a CLI skill-style wrapper for Codex, Kimi, and Antigravity coder/reviewer loops.

interface.shortDescription: Run paired coder/reviewer CLI agent loops.
interface.longDescription: Agent Chain Wrapper exposes this repository's AgentChain runner as a CLI skill-style wrapper. It can run Codex, Kimi, Antigravity, or another configured coding CLI with a reviewing CLI, then repeat until the review approves or max iterations are reached.
defaultPrompt: Run AgentChain with Codex as coder and a CLI reviewer.
Create an AgentChain config for this project.
Use AgentChain to code, review, and revise.
